scope: External E1 two-axis STS3215 neck controller rewrite and local D455 viewer
implementation: MoonBit protocol, command guard, startup, movement, receipts, simulation and audit; thin Linux C serial and durable-file binding

native_transport_qualification.sanitizer: GCC AddressSanitizer, system allocator, matching MoonBit runtime sources

legacy_one_off_helpers: slow_neck_test, recover_neck and disable_neck were archived as non-executable text and replaced with failing stubs outside the repository
limitations: Software cannot guarantee zero motion after hardware power loss or torque release
Movement bounds are a conservative commissioning envelope, not a full mechanical clearance qualification
The CLI monitors only while a command runs; it is not a continuous safety-rated watchdog
Execution receipt files are trusted local MoonRobo artifacts
No new physical movement was used to qualify the rewrite
